$comment: Dependencies without a 'platform' field are built by vcpkg on every platform.
Qt and OpenCV are taken from the distribution on Linux: vcpkg's qtbase needs a
pile of apt-installed X11/GL/fontconfig headers there regardless, so building it
from source would cost an hour of CI and buy nothing.

enables ffmpeg by default, which drags in qtdeclarative and leaves bare
